caption:
How to build a customer FAQ from your own inbox with AI

Your customers already told you what to put in your FAQ. It's sitting in your inbox.

Copy this:

"Here are customer questions from the last month. List the ones people ask more than once, in their own words. Group duplicates, count them, and sort by most asked. Questions: [PASTE QUESTIONS ONLY]"

How to use it:
1) Copy only the questions, not whole emails.
2) Remove names, emails and order numbers.
3) Answer the top 3 once and pin them where people book.

On an invented dog groomer's inbox, nail trims without a full groom came out on top. That's an FAQ heading and a saved reply, written by your customers.
